The test image shows a corn **leaf** with:
- Several tan/brown rectangular-ish lesions with reddish-brown margins, bounded by veins
- Scattered yellow-green speckling/flecking across the leaf surface
- Lesions appear elongated and irregular

Let me check the part index, then start viewing reference images.
Leaf part confirmed. Top candidates: Gray_Leaf_Spot, Southern_Corn_Leaf_Blight, Northern_Leaf_Blight, Physoderma_Brown_Spot, Eyespot. Starting broad coverage.
Gray Leaf Spot shows narrow elongated lesions. The test image lesions are larger and more irregular. Let me check Southern Corn Leaf Blight.
This is a strong match - same tan/brown elongated lesions with yellow-green speckling on a similar leaf. Let me check Northern Leaf Blight next.
NLB shows large cigar-shaped lesions - different from the test image. Checking Physoderma Brown Spot.
Physoderma shows banded yellow-orange speckling with dark midrib spots - partially matches the speckling but not the larger lesions. Let me check more candidates.
Eyespot shows many small circular spots - not matching. Checking Common Rust.
Common Rust shows typical dark pustules - not matching. Checking Goss's Wilt.
Goss's Wilt shows large water-soaked areas - not matching. Checking Holcus Spot.
Holcus Spot shows single circular spots - not matching. Checking Stewart's Disease.
Stewart's Disease shows long bleached streaks - not matching. Checking Anthracnose Leaf Spot.
Anthracnose shows irregular tan lesions with dark margins - some similarity but different pattern. Checking Tar Spot.
Tar Spot shows black raised dots - not matching. Checking Southern Rust.
Southern Rust shows orange pustules - not matching. Checking Carbonum Leaf Spot.
Carbonum shows elongated lesions in string-of-pearls pattern - somewhat similar but different density. Checking Maize Dwarf Mosaic Virus.
MDMV shows mosaic streaking - not matching. Checking Maize Streak Virus.
Maize Streak Virus shows distinctive yellow streaks - not matching. Checking Corn Stunt Spiroplasma.

I've now viewed 16 reference images across 16 different classes. 

**Summary of comparisons:**
- **Southern_Corn_Leaf_Blight** (Corn_Disease_24): Best match — tan/brown elongated lesions with reddish margins AND yellow-green speckling scattered across the leaf, similar field background with red soil
- **Gray_Leaf_Spot**: Narrower, more uniformly rectangular lesions — less similar
- **Northern_Leaf_Blight**: Large cigar-shaped lesions — different scale/shape
- **Physoderma_Brown_Spot**: Banded yellow-orange speckling with dark midrib spots — partial match on speckling only
- All others (Rust, Eyespot, Tar Spot, Viruses, etc.): Clearly different patterns

The test image has tan/brown irregular lesions with reddish-brown margins and scattered yellow-green speckling — matching SCLB Race O description and the reference image most closely.
